summary: Keep daily release bodies within GitHub's limit and attach complete release notes

replay.detail: Release tooling only; no runtime replay change.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change.

manual.detail: No runtime upgrade action required. Daily releases always attach complete RELEASE-NOTES.md and UPGRADE-IMPACT.json. Oversized bodies show classification counts and bounded one-line upgrade summaries with PR/source links, prioritizing manual actions and breaking changes, then report omitted items. The full upgrade guide remains in the attached notes. Dry runs report body sizing.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
